# driver answers (drive_heretic.py):
#  'Which trial do you want to use?'            -> A: exit | B call1: 'continue' | B call2: the trial chosen by select_rule.py
#  'How many additional trials do you want to run?' -> --n-additional
#  'What do you want to do with the decensored model?' -> 'save' then exit
#  'Path to the folder:'                        -> adapters/<tag>_selected
#  'How do you want to export the model?'       -> ExportStrategy.ADAPTER
#  'How would you like to proceed?'             -> supplied via --checkpoint-action (never reaches questionary)
#  anything else                                -> logged + exit code 3 (never guessed)
